doc_requests.documents: Before the Everyday Current Account can be opened, we need the beneficial owner's documents for German Fechner B.Eng.: (1) a valid government-issued photo ID for Mr Fechner, and (2) a signed beneficial-owner declaration confirming he owns and controls the funds in the account. Please also provide documented source of funds for Mr Fechner, since he will be funding the account. Note: the account must be held in the name of the person who owns and controls the funds; if Mr Fechner is the beneficial owner, the bank will need to discuss how the account is structured before it can be opened in your name.
